label: X690-48x-2q-4c
description: ExtremeSwitching X690-48x-2q-4c (part 17350) - 1RU 10G leaf, ExtremeXOS: 48x 1Gb/10G SFP+ (ports 1:1-1:48), 2x 10Gb/40Gb QSFP+ (ports 1:49-1:50), 4x 10Gb/25Gb/40Gb/50Gb/100Gb QSFP28 (ports 1:51-1:54). All 54 ports are optical cages; the copper twin is the separate X690-48t-2q-4c (17360), which is 48x 10GBASE-T.
notes: Vendor wording (Extreme X690 Quick Reference, 121148-00): "X690-48x-2q-4c Base unit, 48 1Gb/10Gb SFP+ ports, 2 10Gb/40Gb QSFP+ ports, 4 10Gb/25Gb/40Gb/50Gb/100Gb QSFP28 ports"; the same document's front-panel legend says "1Gb/10GBASE-T ports (48t model) or 1Gb/10Gb SFP+ ports (48x model)". Until this pass the ports carried no connector at all, so every port was modelled as an RJ45 socket (audit-port-types, the #60 shape) - wrong for all 54.
